messages:
emma: Hey all — I put up a PRD draft for the Console observability initiative (data lifecycle + tracing UX + dashboard onboarding). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/console-observability-datalifecycle. Need prioritization and concrete acceptance criteria by EOD Fri so we can lock scope for the Q2 roadmap. Key asks from customers: exportable traces, per-project retention tiers, and a cost-preview in the UI.

kai: skimmed — big flag on 90d full-trace retention requested by ACME. Cost will be huge. Propose tiered storage: 7d full traces, 30d sampled/aggregated traces, 90d metadata-only/indexed spans. That meets compliance asks without linear cost.

sanjay: +1 to tiering. Edge-case: what about long-running requests that span retention boundaries? We need a rule for reconstructing traces when partial spans are gone. Suggest: keep trace index + root summary for 90d, full payload for shorter tiers.

jessica: UX note — user flow should make cost impact explicit before they save retention settings. I can deliver a mock that includes a monthly cost delta preview and a confirmation modal that explains data loss implications. Needs product acceptance criteria to validate.

emma: Agree on tier proposal as default. Drafting an initial rollout plan: canary 10% tenants w/ >1TB/month flagged as opt-in, run for 2 weeks, measure error/latency + cost delta. If metrics good, ramp to 50% then GA. Also: define acceptance criteria (below).

docbot: Document updated by emma (pm): https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/console-observability-datalifecycle (version 3).

kai: Acceptance criteria suggestions (engineering):
- API surface: POST /v1/retention with validation and per-project override (smoke test).
- Backend: retention tiers implemented, automated TTL enforcement + index snapshotting.
- Performance: no >5% increase in query p99 for trace lookups in canary tenants.
- Cost: projected monthly cost delta for canary <= +20% vs baseline.

jessica: Acceptance criteria (design/UX):
- Cost preview shows estimated delta within ±10% of measured canary cost.
- Retention settings flow includes clear microcopy about data permanence and export options.
- Trace viewer gracefully handles missing spans and shows reconstructed trace with markers indicating gaps.

emma: Acceptance criteria (product / launch gates):
- All canary metrics pass (latency, error rate, cost threshold).
- Manual signoff from security on export API and encryption-at-rest/HSM keys.
- Docs + in-console help ready.
- Migration plan for existing projects >30d retention (opt-in automated convert).

kai: Edge cases we need to call out in the PRD:
- Partial traces: UI should show partial warning and offer "export available segments".
- High-cardinality tag explosion when keeping indexes 90d — we need a compaction job or risk blowing up index size.
- Multi-region customers: ensure region-aware retention (don't replicate long-term data cross-region without consent).

sanjay: Also: sampling controls must be stable under autoscaling. If collectors drop events during scale, we need a backfill plan or accept data loss. Document a fallback policy: if ingestion backlog > X, temporarily lower sampling and alert.

jessica: Small UX ask: add an "estimate cost for N users" mode in the preview so infra teams can model tenant growth.

emma: Good call. I'll add that. Action items:
- emma: update PRD with tier defaults, rollout plan, and acceptance criteria (today).
- jessica: mock retention flow + cost preview (Weds).
- kai: prototype TTL enforcement job + cost model (end of week).
- sanjay: doc sampling/backfill behavior & failure modes (Thu).

emma: Final question for prioritization: is export-API GA necessary for initial rollout or can it be v1-beta (restricted)? Customer asks push for GA but eng prefers beta to reduce scope. Thoughts?

kai: Recommend v1-beta (restricted keys + rate limit). We can deliver full GA in Q3 after performance proofs.

jessica: Beta ok if UI clearly labels it and there is a sign-up flow.

sanjay: Fine with beta as long as there's a documented escalation path for customers that need GA earlier.

emma: OK we’ll mark export API as "beta: gated" in the PRD. Thanks everyone — please add comments inline on the doc. :thumbsup:
